metadata.description: An application-essay reviewing and drafting skill for international applicants to Japanese English-medium programmes and for scholarship essays.

plugins.name: application-essay-studio
plugins.description: Review, stress-test, restructure and draft application essays. Four ordered passes (administrative, accuracy, structure, line), a thirteen-dimension rubric, a four-layer fact-check, and a six-seat admissions committee that rejects by default and iterates until the applicant calls it done.
